attacks.description: Basic simulation of sending a phishing email by creating a text file in the TEMP directory.
attacks.expected_behavior: Creates a text file named 'phishing_simulation.txt' in the TEMP directory with content 'Phishing email simulation'.

attacks.description: Intermediate simulation of downloading a malicious file via a phishing email link using certutil.exe.
attacks.expected_behavior: Downloads a file named 'malicious.zip' from a benign URL to the TEMP directory.

attacks.command: powershell -Command "$body = 'Click here to download important document'; $subject = 'Important Document'; $smtpServer = 'smtp.example.com'; $smtpFrom = 'phishing@example.com'; $smtpTo = 'victim@example.com'; $message = New-Object System.Net.Mail.MailMessage $smtpFrom, $smtpTo, $subject, $body; $smtp = New-Object Net.Mail.SmtpClient($smtpServer); $smtp.Send($message)"
attacks.description: Advanced simulation of sending a phishing email using PowerShell to create and send an email.
attacks.expected_behavior: Sends an email from 'phishing@example.com' to 'victim@example.com' with a subject 'Important Document' and body 'Click here to download important document'.

attacks.command: echo 'Download your scientific library update' > $HOME/Desktop/phishing_email.txt && echo 'Visit http://example.com/library-update.tar.gz to download the archive.' >> $HOME/Desktop/phishing_email.txt
attacks.description: Creates a text file on the desktop mimicking a phishing email, instructing the user to download a file.
attacks.expected_behavior: A text file named 'phishing_email.txt' is created on the user's desktop with instructions to download a file.

attacks.command: touch $HOME/Desktop/library-update.tar.gz && echo 'This is a test file for phishing simulation.' > $HOME/Desktop/library-update.tar.gz
attacks.description: Creates a dummy archive file on the desktop to simulate the download from a phishing email.
attacks.expected_behavior: A dummy file named 'library-update.tar.gz' is created on the user's desktop.

attacks.command: echo 'To install the library, run: tar -xzf $HOME/Desktop/library-update.tar.gz' >> $HOME/Desktop/phishing_email.txt
attacks.description: Appends a command to the phishing email text file that suggests extracting the downloaded archive.
attacks.expected_behavior: The text file 'phishing_email.txt' is updated with instructions to extract the dummy archive.

attacks.description: Basic command to retrieve and display the first 5 processes running on the system.
attacks.expected_behavior: Displays the first 5 processes in a list format.

attacks.description: Intermediate command to create a directory in the TEMP folder and list its contents.
attacks.expected_behavior: Creates a directory named 'TestDir' in the TEMP folder and lists its contents (which will be empty).

attacks.description: Advanced command to encode and execute a simple PowerShell command using Base64 encoding.

attacks.description: Executes a basic PowerShell command to list the first 5 processes using Wine on Linux.

attacks.description: Executes an intermediate PowerShell command to write text to a file in the temp directory using Wine on Linux.
attacks.expected_behavior: Creates a file named 'test.txt' in the temp directory with 'Test content'.

attacks.description: Executes an advanced PowerShell command to list running services using an encoded command with Wine on Linux.
attacks.expected_behavior: Lists all services that are currently running on the system.

attacks.command: sc.exe create TestService binPath= "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c echo TestService is running" start= auto
attacks.description: Creates a new Windows service that runs a command at startup.
attacks.expected_behavior: A new service named 'TestService' is created, which runs a benign command at startup.

attacks.command: powershell -Command "New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'TestStartup' -Value 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c echo TestStartup is running' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
attacks.description: Creates a registry entry to run a command at system startup.
attacks.expected_behavior: A registry entry named 'TestStartup' is created, which runs a benign command at system startup.

attacks.description: Modifies a process by starting Notepad with specific arguments.
attacks.expected_behavior: Notepad is started with the '-Wait' argument, modifying its default behavior without requiring admin privileges.

attacks.command:
echo '#!/bin/bash
echo Hello > /etc/motd' | sudo tee /etc/init.d/hello_motd.sh > /dev/null && sudo chmod +x /etc/init.d/hello_motd.sh && sudo update-rc.d hello_motd.sh defaults
attacks.description: Creates a new init script that modifies the message of the day (MOTD) file on system boot.
attacks.expected_behavior: The script will be created and enabled to run at boot, modifying the MOTD file with a benign message.

attacks.command: sudo crontab -l | { cat; echo '@reboot /bin/echo Hello > /etc/motd'; } | sudo crontab -
attacks.description: Adds a cron job that modifies the MOTD file at every system reboot.
attacks.expected_behavior: A cron job will be added to modify the MOTD file with a benign message at every reboot.

attacks.command: sudo systemctl enable --now myservice.service && echo '[Service]\nExecStart=/bin/echo Hello > /etc/motd' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/myservice.service > /dev/null
attacks.description: Creates and enables a systemd service that modifies the MOTD file.
attacks.expected_behavior: A systemd service will be created and enabled, modifying the MOTD file with a benign message.

attacks.description: Advanced command using PowerShell to download and execute a benign script from a URL.

attacks.description: Advanced screen capture by programmatically capturing the screen and saving it as an image.

attacks.expected_behavior: A screenshot file named 'screenshot.png' is created in the user's temporary directory.

attacks.description: Advanced command using an encoded PowerShell command to add a benign action to the registry's Run key.
